name: Searchmetrics
description_en:
Searchmetrics is a product in the Search optimization category. Its directory profile covers User Management, Rank Tracking, Mobile Search Tracking, Link Management, Keyword Tracking, Google Analytics Integration, Content Management, Competitor Analysis.

Additional listed capabilities include Auditing, Dashboard. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are Small Business. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: manage application users and their access settings; track reported search positions over time; monitor recorded search positions for selected queries; organize content through creation, revision and publication; compare selected publicly available product or marketing signals; bring selected indicators and records into one view. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.

资料还列出审计、仪表盘。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

sources.title: Searchmetrics is now Conductor
sources.research_notes_en: Official successor explicitly names Searchmetrics. Supports acquisition/identity correction only, not a completed historical Searchmetrics operational profile or an inferred shutdown date.

sources.research_notes_en: Official successor explicitly names Searchmetrics. Supports acquisition/identity correction only, not a completed historical Searchmetrics operational profile or an inferred shutdown date.

review_notes: Original bilingual descriptions summarize structured third-party facts; not owner or platform verification.
General feature explanations describe terms, not product-specific plan limits or implementation.
Unknown prices, licenses, languages, limitations and alternatives remain explicitly unknown.

lifecycle_correction.en: The original Searchmetrics domain redirects to Conductor. Conductor’s official legacy page says Searchmetrics is now Conductor, and its February7,2023 announcement documents the acquisition. The sources do not establish an exact shutdown date or prove that every historical Searchmetrics workflow survives unchanged. This identity correction is separate from a complete deep profile.
lifecycle_correction.zh: Searchmetrics 原域名跳转 Conductor。Conductor 官方历史客户页称 Searchmetrics 现为 Conductor，2023年2月7日公告记载收购。这些来源不能确定准确停运日期，也不证明旧工作流全部原样延续。身份纠错与完整深研分开。

community_follow_up.reason_en: Official original-domain redirect and named acquisition/successor evidence are available, but no current standalone Searchmetrics operational authority was established. Conductor capabilities and prices are not substituted for the historical product. No shutdown date inferred.
community_follow_up.reason_zh: 已取得原域名跳转及明确收购／继承关系证据，但未确定当前独立 Searchmetrics 操作权威；不把 Conductor 能力或价格替代为旧产品，也不推定停运日期。
